_comment: Single shared mapping from stock ticker to Bitget tokenized-stock BASE symbol, used by ALL portfolios (Grok, Claude, DeepSeek, GPT) -- Bitget's tokenized-stock catalog isn't portfolio-specific, MU means rMU regardless of which portfolio holds it. Confirmed format: 'r' prefix, traded as <symbol>USDT (e.g. MU -> rMU -> rMUUSDT). null = confirmed NOT available on Bitget. Absent entirely = not yet checked; picked up automatically by the daily ticker-mapping-suggestion workflow.

_cash_proxies._comment: Tickers any portfolio might report as a cash-equivalent (e.g. T-bill ETFs). Bitget doesn't tokenize these -- held as idle USDT instead of traded.

_unavailable_on_bitget._comment: Confirmed via live API check, not just absent from this file.
